reviews.title: I can actually do this
reviews.text: Doing these workouts actually feel possible and I can get them done without equipment. App works just as it’s expected. Very easy!

reviews.title: Good exercises
reviews.text: Good app for calisthenics, and it's good for beginners. One thing I don't like is that it's has a subscription service to unlock all the features. I'd prefer if there was a one time buy option.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text:
It’s easy and great to use there are a niche amount of workouts but the ones being used on this app provide great results and easy rest times in-between reps. 

My only gripe is that the save button when completing a set requires multiple presses and doesn’t function with a single press. Probably a bug.

reviews.title: Anyone can do this at any age. And you should!
reviews.text:
Hampton and his team have done a great job taking simple exercises and making them fit anybody with zero equipment and short duration workouts.

I recommended this to my parents, friends, coworkers etc. it scales in difficulty to meet you where you are at.

I majored in exercise science and have been an athlete most of my life. Now in the dad phase I don’t have much time and this allows me to start and stop without getting hurt pushing myself too hard but it also can get tough and really build trust strength. I also really value the flexibility.

Great work guys!

reviews.title: Exactly what I’ve needed!
reviews.text: As a mother of young children, I find it so hard to develop my own workout routine, esp after several years without regular exercise. This app removes the mental load and allows me to get started with clear instructions and accessible goals.

reviews.title: App should incorporate Mobility
reviews.text:
The app is great for Calisthenics workouts which was partially why I downloaded the app but one of the bigger reasons was because I have bad shoulder pain from a minor rotator cuff injury but know that strengthening/stretching over time would help. In advertisement it showed great stretches that could relieve pain over time. 
Going through the app i couldnt find any of that information or any plans for it. 
Also being someone that already works out at the gym regularly this would be a great way to improve my workouts and livelihood overall.

reviews.title: Promising
reviews.text: I’ve tried many times to start with body weight training and calisthenics in the past, but without a program to rely on or just word of mouth for exercises, I always ended up quitting within a week. Hybrid doesn’t talk down to you and the exercises are easy to follow. I can see myself sticking to this for the long haul.

reviews.title: Best way to build from beginner
reviews.text: This is so easy to follow and to feel confident starting out as a beginner and working your way up to some amazing stuff

reviews.title: Incredible app
reviews.text: I never have any problems with it, ads aren't obnoxious, and at first I thought it was going to just be easy but it's really quite challenging. I feel like I'm actually getting somewhere when I use this app.

reviews.title: Premium...
reviews.text: To many requests to join premium and to many adds

reviews.title: Can’t wait to see any updates
reviews.text: I love how you can use this & benefit even if you don’t pay. I think it’d be cool to add more workout features that can adapt to situations on the day to day like ankle raises while in line/work/etc or wall sits when leaning against a wall etc. & how it helps you in some ways to improve the self. Also I got into the app from YouTube ads which I usually don’t trust, almost didn’t download until I realized it wasn’t ai slop. I trust the creator as I love his videos & energy but I thought someone was using his likeness for their own app.

reviews.title: genuinely so good and helpful
reviews.text:
i will be absolutely honest here, this app is one of the best exercise apps i’ve ever tried out. this guy hampton and his team did a great job with this one!! i saw an ad on insta so i decided to see what’s this about and the app is genuinely so GREAT! the work outs are generated specifically for your level of fitness with helpful gif demonstrations and text descriptions of the exercise. and to have the timed breaks in between sets is also such a useful feature! what also made a good impression on me is that the app doesn’t force you to buy the premium and even without premium you still get the perks! now, this only makes me want to support the app and buy that premium because this project was obviously created for a good cause - to help people like me to get strong and healthy. thank you hybrid.calisthenics <3

p.s. as a person who always on the look out for the apps tht buy bot reviews and other stuff to promote the app or to get the higher rating, i am saying that this review was so totally written by a real human being who is not a bot lol i don’t usually write reviews but this is app is genuinely great so i had to lol it’s pretty simple and easy to ise and free  and genuinely helpful!! anyways xoxo 💋💅🏻

I’ve loved watching your videos for years, but today is the first day I’ve started working out with you. I’m starting at level -10, but am excited to see how far I can progress.

reviews.title: BEST. FOR. RECOVERY.

(with feet on the ground of course:) Stellar app, love how there’s only positive reinforcement and no “HOW COME YOU’VE BEEN ABSENT” emails, lolllll! Gotta get this app!!!!!!!!!! 👊

reviews.title: Straight to the point!

reviews.title: Easy but helpful

reviews.title: Motivation
reviews.text: I like that you don’t have to pay extra if you don’t want extra

reviews.title: No offline capability
reviews.text: As much as I want to give it 5 stars I have no way of using it when I am away from WiFi. It has great navigation ability and easy to do and understand work outs. Heck even the beginning questionnaire was great. Unfortunately being unable to have service and not able to use the app while not being logged in makes it impossible for me to use it at all. Also paying $100 for a year or paying for a monthly subscription is way out of my budget. They also make you choose the yearly subscription if you want to do the 7 day free trial. Overall a really good product if you don’t have connection issues and have the budget that can work with that.

reviews.title: Simple but also a bit lazy
reviews.text: This app is fine. For a guy who spends his time making videos, it would make sense to actually include some audio explaining how to do the exercise and its importance.  If you have levels for each exercise, it would also make sense to let me select the level I want. For timed exercises, why not add a countdown instead? It's missing a lot, and for now, I don't see the value in paying for a subscription.

reviews.title: Fantastic App
reviews.text:
Simple, straight forward, calisthenics strength training app.

It actually helps you get better and always meets you where you’re at regardless of experience level, high or low.

reviews.title: Finally something that leads with positivity
reviews.text: So many of these apps try to tap into insecurities, whether it’s weight loss, what people think of you, etc. This app takes you where you’re at and adjusts to you so you can start gently and move forward. Motivates without body shaming!

reviews.title: Audio adds
reviews.text:
I like Hammond and the Hybrid Calisthenics program. The app does a wonderful job at explaining exercises as well as setting clear goals. 

For my first week of use I had no problems and would recommend the app. Unfortunately after the first week I started receiving audio adds every time I logged a set. These adds would interrupt whatever music or book I was listening to and really soured my experience with using the app. 

If there is a way to disable audio adds I’ll change my review but right now I may go back to using a google sheet to track progress instead of the app.

reviews.title: Clean and simple design makes working out easy
reviews.text:
I appreciate the friendly and simple UI that guides you through a doable workout in a Hampton-friendly way. I have the book too, which helps with details on how to do the move. 

Please always keep a simple “bare bones” option on the app. I’ve seen too many other apps go down the route of complexity for complexities sake, ruining what made me the app so great in the first place. The “Have a Beautiful Day” at the end of the workout made me smile. 

I’ve wanted to learn calisthenics for a while. With the help of the app, Hampton’s videos and book, I’m actually doing it!
